scope: Read-only source review plus original exact three regression bodies; not final batch qualification or full test-suite certification.
source_reasoning: bounds validates offset(row), offset(row+1), local previous-boundary strict ordering and raw inverse at start/end-1; no recursive at/bounds cycle.
layout checks capacity first, then only its materialized visible/overscan row span. MaxRows limits that scan to4096; neither hidden row count nor total extent drives the validation loop.
Snapshot validates prospective geometry before allocating cell records; SetViewport/ReplaceSource/activateKey commit only after admitted geometry, anchor/identity and final stamp/endpoint checks.
Empty row sources have zero total and do not call RowAt; positive/checked helper prefix and total+header validation preserve half-open finite int geometry.
Anchor shrink uses min(old offset,new height-1); addition stays below new row end. Page saturates pixel targets and preserves endpoint/tall-row progress semantics.
Context helper preallocation, periodic cancellation and private copied prefix remain unchanged by this correction.
limits: Only accessed endpoints/adjacent row boundaries/inverses are validated. Hidden source geometry remains the borrowed immutable-source contract.
Same-revision unversioned content/geometry mutation is outside that source contract; no full hidden geometry validation is claimed.
Later producer tests/spec/SDK/native evidence must bind final frozen bytes separately.
